description: SUPERSEDED by the V1A/V1D parity pass (2026-09-24, see extension/lib/pii-regex.js's header note): bare 12-digit runs used to be Aadhaar-shaped only with a nearby aadhaar/aadhar/uidai keyword. server/pii_regex_v2.py's AADHAAR_RE (ported from dom-scanner.js) was already unconditional and, per the parity ruling ('broader pattern wins in both files'), this file's keyword gate was REMOVED to match it. Same bare 12-digit number, one text with the keyword, one without -- BOTH now flag, proving the gate is genuinely gone rather than just untested.
